meta.scope: Turkey Batch 9 — Digital economy / e-commerce and climate (GHG inventory, NDC) densification.

candidates.title: E-commerce volume and digital trade statistics
candidates.description: Official statistics on e-commerce volume and transaction counts. In 2025 general e-commerce volume exceeded 4.57 trillion TL (roughly USD 115 billion), with strong multi-year growth; retail e-commerce forms a large share. E-commerce accounted for an estimated ~6.9% of GDP in 2025.
candidates.notes: Core digital-commerce statistical product. High-growth series under elevated inflation and digitalisation.

candidates.title: Digital economy framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from Trade Ministry and related sources
candidates.description: Policy and analytical framing of the digital economy and digitalisation of commerce, services and public services. Continuously referenced in competitiveness, SME and platform-economy discussions.

candidates.title: Greenhouse gas inventory statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Environment, Urbanisation and Climate Change / UNFCCC submissions
candidates.description: Official national GHG inventory (National Inventory Document). Recent estimates place total emissions in the low-to-mid 500 MtCO2e range; energy is the dominant source sector.

candidates.title: Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) climate framing
candidates.description: Türkiye’s Nationally Determined Contribution under the Paris Agreement, setting quantified GHG reduction targets relative to a business-as-usual baseline. Continuously cited in climate policy, energy transition and international negotiations.

candidates.title: Turkey digital–climate densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from Trade Ministry and climate sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding e-commerce volume statistics, digital economy framing, GHG inventory statistics, and NDC climate framing into a coherent digital and climate layer.
